claims.text: Indications: all suspected neoplasms and all bullous disorders, or to clarify a diagnosis.
claims.quote: all lesions suspected neoplasms - all bullous disorders - clarify existing dx/leading hypothesis

claims.text: Shave: quick, no sutures (heals by secondary intention); don't do a superficial shave of a pigmented lesion, since full depth is needed to stage melanoma.
claims.quote: Shave: superficial + deep - easy, quick - dermablade or #15 blade - ⍉ sutures: heals 2° intention → small depressed scar - pigmented lesion: ⍉ superficial shave (full depth needed to stage melanoma)

claims.text: Punch (2–10 mm): rashes and small lesions; sutured closed.
claims.quote: Punch: round disposable 2-10 mm - rashes + small lesions - better cosmetics (sutured closed)

claims.text: Suspected melanoma: excisional biopsy preferred, for staging.
claims.quote: Pigmented lesions: suspicious melanoma → excisional PREFERRED (staging)

claims.text: Never destroy a pigmented lesion by cryotherapy or cautery.
claims.quote: NEVER destroy pigmented lesion by cryo or cautery

claims.text: Closure: nonabsorbable 4-0/5-0 on body and scalp, 6-0 on the face.
claims.quote: skin closure: nonabsorbable (silk, nylon, prolene) - 4-0/5-0 body + scalp - 6-0 face

claims.text: Dressing: petrolatum and a bandage; avoid Neosporin (high contact-allergy rate).
claims.quote: moist + occluded dressing (plain vaseline/petrolatum + bandage) - AVOID neosporin (high contact-allergy incidence)
